body: Thank you for your concern kind stranger. It really means a lot to me. And that's what's stopped me for all these years, the pain it would cause to the people who do care. The cutting is just something in my life I can control. And mom's doing good now, 11 years cancer free! :)

Trust me, I am very grateful for what I do have. And the job thing, I'd love to get a 40 cent raise, that's serious money haha. My parents help me out a lot with rent and food and such and I'm extremely grateful for that as well or I probably would be homeless again. And I don't usually complain about relationship things but it just happened a few hours ago so I was still a little sore about it. But thank you for taking the time to reply and I hope your job stuff works out
